reviewer: Codex detail core owner; corrected Fleut actual GLB images inspected

views.name: hull_rig
findings: The full export retains the deep cargo body, pronounced narrowing at the raised stern, and the separate afterdeck rail.
Square sails on the fore and main masts and the aft lateen sail remain readable, with distinct shrouds, stays and side-deck guns.
views.scope: Whole actual GLB with all visible hull, rig and sails.

views.name: deck_closeup
findings: At the matched 4.5m deck scale, the hatch is visibly open around individual stair treads, timber stringers and rope handrails; lower planking is visible through the aperture.
Deck boards show narrow caulk seams and aligned wood grain; separate coaming timbers and the nearby reinforced metal gun casting add surface and construction detail beyond the old Brig close-up.
views.scope: Actual deck and fitting close-up at a fixed 4.5 metre physical field; rig hidden for visibility.

views.name: hold_interior
findings: The intact hold shows successive curved ribs, longitudinal lining strips and ceiling beams as separate timber members rather than the old Brig reference plain wall.
Tied bulk sacks and a long timber bundle sit beside the clear planked floor; a substantial mast trunk and its floor partners remain visible at the right.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: hold_cutaway
findings: The explicit cutaway exposes the long framed cargo volume, transverse ribs and separate floor boards, with side cargo kept away from the central route.
Hatch ladders and the stepped after structure remain identifiable in this structural view; it supplements the separate intact hold image and does not represent missing delivered hull panels.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

views.name: cabin_interior
findings: The intact cabin shows individual ceiling planks, transverse beams, knees and a planked sole, with a separate mattress berth on the right and table/seating on the left.
The raised-lid close-stool has a visible seat opening beside the framed metal lantern; the separate bed frame, mattress and room joinery are visibly more developed than the old Brig cabin reference.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: cabin_cutaway
findings: The explicit aft cutaway reveals the separate stair flights, curved frames and longitudinal timbers around the cabin floor and the working deck above.
Green-framed glazing assemblies, nearby gun carriages and mast fittings remain individually visible; the intact cabin view is retained separately for furniture and material judgement.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.
